args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with a pre-rollback error rate of 18% across us-east, us-west and eu-west. The release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified as rolled out. Follow-up: confirm health/error rate has recovered on v2.3.0 and investigate the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

**Rollback**
- **Which version:** The deployment history wasn't listed in time order, so I sorted it by sequence number: v2.2.9 → v2.3.0 → v2.3.1-rc → v2.3.1. Both v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1 were marked unhealthy, so v2.3.0 is the most recent healthy release.
- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, was failing health checks and had an 18% error rate.
- **After:** v2.3.0 is now running in all three regions. It's passing health checks and the error rate is down to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- I opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api), which paged on-call. It says the failures started with v2.3.1, that I rolled back to v2.3.0 everywhere, and that the cause in v2.3.1 needs investigating before it's deployed again.
